dialogues.speaker: Voynich Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: To promote various economic activities in Nasha Town, we of the Voynich Guild believe that it is necessary to create a platform where the vox populi may be heard in a manner both authoritative and convenient to use. To this end, we have set up this bulletin board.

dialogues.speaker: Voynich Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: Any information with potential economic value can be posted here — including but not limited to: item trades, collaboration offers, treasure clues, or even just complaints, and so on...

dialogues.speaker: Voynich Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: This board has no restrictions on content or format. Everyone is free to speak their mind. We hope you encounter endless business opportunities here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Disclaimers & Indemnities
dialogues.text: The Voynich Guild assumes no legal or financial liability for the authenticity, accuracy, or consequences of posted content, nor does it offer dispute mediation services.

dialogues.speaker: Disclaimers & Indemnities
dialogues.text: Please bear the consequence of any emotional breakdowns, financial loss, personal injury, etc. caused by the content on the bulletin board, or seek out third parties to resolve the issue. By reading these terms, you acknowledge that you accept them.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Returning to my hometown. Selling one Fatui uniform. Large size, men's, 80% new. Price negotiable, but will definitely be a worthwhile deal."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If you are interested in joining the Fatui, this is your best choice. But even if you don't, you can wear the uniform on the following occasions..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "You can wear it to work to let your colleagues know that you are not to be trifled with. You can wear it to Snezhnaya to let the people know that you are not to be trifled with. You can wear it while venturing through the wilderness to let passersby know that you are not to be trifled with... You get my drift, yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "For the next few days, I'll be waiting at Speranza with my clothes, so that you can check the goods before you buy them. First come, first served. If I'm not there, that means someone came before you did."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Can anyone recommend a truly skilled doctor? My wife's been getting more sick by the day — but every physician we've consulted can't even identify the cause of her illness!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Her condition just keeps getting worse. These days, she can only stay awake for four hours a day... Please, someone, help us!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "How about you try going elsewhere? There are better doctors in Sumeru, Liyue, or maybe Fontaine... I don't think there's much hope asking around in a place like this."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "I thought so too, but my wife can't leave Nod-Krai. Without kuuvahki, she'll die!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Huh? I've only heard of people who can't adapt well TO kuuvahki, and even some of those Frostmoon Scions have folks like that... Is it even possible to die from a lack of it?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "It's true! Without kuuvahki, she can't fly, and her face gets all blurry and laggy... Just watching her makes my heart shatter!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "She can't fly, and her face... Wait, your wife's a robot?! Man, I think YOU need to see a doctor more than she does!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "No! I refuse! No matter what anyone tells me, she's my darling wife, who has silently hovered by my side all this time!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "...Alright, suit yourself, mate. But I'll throw you a bone: Go look for Aino."

dialogues.speaker: Northland Bank Poster
dialogues.text: The Northland Bank proudly presents its newest wealth management product: Happy Home Loans! Because happy families begin with flexible financing.

dialogues.speaker: Northland Bank Poster
dialogues.text: Planning to buy your child their first Magic Guide? Repairing the creaky old family home for your elders? Or perhaps planning a cross-border honeymoon with your beloved?

dialogues.speaker: Northland Bank Poster
dialogues.text: With Happy Home Loans, we can support your dreams, and make your home happy as can be! Each day of delayed payment will automatically enroll you in the Happiness Extension Plan — where your interest rates grow alongside your joy.

dialogues.speaker: Northland Bank Poster
dialogues.text: Any unpaid balance from this term will automatically roll into your principal, letting your children uphold the family's credit legacy together! Happy Home Loans — You don't just own your love and responsibility, you also look after it for the next generation!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Lucrative Offer: Seeking a guide intimately familiar with all of Nod-Krai. We only have one non-negotiable requirement: Beauty. My master simply cannot abide an... aesthetically challenged escort anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Sounds like you're looking for me! Nobody can name a better guide than I, Ratimir, 'round these parts! You'll find me charming clients at the harbor on the daily. Come find me if you're interested in the real deal!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "You do not meet our requirements. Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "We've received intel that the Wild Hunt has appeared, and us Wild Hunters are about to make our move. Right now, our team has a professional guide and photographer, so we're hiring a bodyguard!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "We've received intel that the Wild Hunt has appeared, and us Wild Hunters are about to make our move. We're looking for a professional tour guide and two bodyguards!"

dialogues.speaker: Notice from the Lightkeepers
dialogues.text: There have been many Wild Hunt-related disasters of late. Yesterday, the Lightkeepers rescued a team of civilians from the Wild Hunt, of which only one member survived. It is extremely dangerous to approach the Wild Hunt without proper authorization. Please cherish your lives and stay away from unnecessary danger.

dialogues.speaker: Shakily-Written Note
dialogues.text: "Giving away an old Kamera and a set of Wild Hunt-related photos for free. Just take what you like. I don't want to keep any of it..."

dialogues.speaker: Belt Operator's Notice
dialogues.text: ATTENTION: All cargo labels must face upward on the conveyor belt! If mis-sorted or misplaced due to noncompliance (whether taken by others or dumped in port warehouses), retrieval is your responsibility!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Well, well! There've been a lot of mistakes with cargo recently, and you still dare to toss out a 'notice' like this? Looks like SOMEONE'S trying to shift the blame..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "That idiotic 'someone' (with no consideration for those who work sorting, the blighter) you're looking for is Sakkari, one of those upper level, upper-crust types running the dock. I saw him putting up that notice with my own eyes!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I fully endorse everyone who messes up the packages on his conveyor belt, just to spite the buffoon! The only thing upper-crust about him is the Mora lining his fat pockets!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Dear homeland, and dear relatives, I never imagined that our day of parting would come so soon."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It's all thanks to this investment coupon from Mimisbrunnr Books. My days as a penniless, luckless pauper are now far behind me!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Tomorrow, I'll be enjoying afternoon tea at the Hotel Debord, and in a few days, I'll be able to enjoy the golden sun shining down on the cliffs from Mt. Tianheng. This world truly is vast beyond compare!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Do not worry, dear loved ones, bosom friends. I'll spend all this money. Yes, every last Mora! And with that, I bid you tally-ho!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Oh my days, I can't even bear to keep reading this... Look, based on my own painful experience, here's a breakdown of the most common scams. If you're reading this, count yourself lucky."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The ■■■■ trick. In this scam, the scammers usually claim to have ■■■■... And as long as you jump in ■■■■ early, you can be part of ■■■■."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "In the first few months, maybe ■■■■... Your 'partners' might suddenly ■■■■. And as it turns out, ■■■■ would already be ■■■■."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This type of trick clings to our local scammers like stench clings to a dead dog."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But no matter how skilled a scammer may be, they'll fold the moment you ask, "■■■■," my friends..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Who erased my message?! Darn and blast, it's definitely one of those filthy scammers! Did anyone see who did it?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looking for a roommate to split rent. I'm eyeing a place in the upper levels, but it's pricey for a solo tenant. If you'd like, I can give you the bedroom with the better view."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'm not picky about gender, just as long as you have a decent job in Nasha Town and don't mind pets. I'm at The Flagship every Friday night, so let's chat over a drink first if you're interested."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "EVERYBODY! DO *NOT* TAKE UP THIS GUY'S OFFER! I was his previous roommate... He doesn't have a "pet," he has a whole gosh-darn menagerie!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Like chic badgers and whatnot... It's not a problem if they're locked up, but when they're not... Well, there was this one time I had to use the loo at night, and I stepped on a still-warm pile of... Yeah, I'm never forgetting that 'sensation' as long as I live and breathe."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "I knew it! You killed Blooey, and you tried to pin it on Chubsy! I'll get you yet, you villain!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looking for fellow Mora-minded compatriots! I have major leads about Reed Miller's legendary treasure. We already have a treasure-hunting team, and we're just waiting for more of y'all to join our cause!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This is a rare opportunity! All I need is one final sum of starting capital so I can rent the 'Legendary Treasure Compass' and get in touch with some key informants."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "ROI: 900%, and that's the absolute minimum — if all goes well, you can recoup your investment within a month! Meet me in person at the Northland Bank to transfer funds and negotiate terms. As a bonus, I'll even throw in a free treasure map!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "There's only one spot left, so come quick, or it'll be gone forever! Miss out on this, and you just might find yourself working under me instead of with me!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looking for a partner. Ideal candidate is male, aged 25-35, with a pleasant appearance and gentle temperament. Must be willing to provide attentive care for my daughter in everyday life. Must not be the arguing type."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Salary need only cover the gentleman's personal expenses. Priority given to current Sumeru Akademiya faculty or Fontaine Research Institute researchers."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Basic information about my daughter: I own ten properties in Nasha Town. If you are interested, please contact..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Uhhh... Contact who? Why's that part of the message torn out?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Help! I accidentally ordered 25 kilograms of bamboo shoots... If my family finds out, they'll lose their minds, and I might loss my head! Please, someone, buy them off me!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "What are bamboo shoots? What are they for?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "It's a special ingredient that a merchant from Liyue recommended to me. They said it's used to make delicious 'Bamboo Shoot Soup' or 'Triple-Layered Consommé'... So I wanted to buy some to try..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Doesn't sound like anything I know how to work with... Maybe you should ask Katya at Speranza. She's got a super chef over there, and they might be able to make use of your bamboo shoots."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Now I feel like eating there..."

dialogues.speaker: Frostmoon Scions' Bulletin
dialogues.text: "When you stand alone, wrapped in layers of darkness and cold... When even your words freeze in your throat... Call upon the name of Lady Kuutar."

dialogues.speaker: Frostmoon Scions' Bulletin
dialogues.text: "If you feel lost in the mortal world beneath the moonlight, the Frostmoon Scions will join you in waiting for the gentle glow of the moon. May it illuminate your road ahead."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "And when the moon shines not, you can always trust in your kuuvahki devices!"

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Notice
dialogues.text: Glory does not fall from the heavens — it must be forged by your own hands! You who call yourself ambitious, the Fatui have a special offer for you today!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Notice
dialogues.text: Whether you're an adventurer, a treasure hunter, or just an ordinary person who hasn't been chosen by fate...Your loyalty and courage are what Snezhnaya needs.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Notice
dialogues.text: If you wish to be a part of this mission, please contact Kruchek at The Flagship and complete your registration.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Once you've registered, don't forget to purchase a life insurance policy for yourself! That way, whether your mission is completed or not, it's still Mora in the bank. For further details, please contact Hrovoje."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Who in the world approved that cannon in the town square? Everyone knows kuuvahki messes with people something fierce. And with kids playing nearby, this just feels like bad news waiting to happen..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Last time I stood around it for half an hour, my head started spinning. There must be something wrong with the cannon! For everyone's safety, we have to dismantle it!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Excuse you! If we get rid of the cannon, what's going to happen when the Wild Hunt attacks? Are we going to just sit on our hands and take the entire calamity on the chin?"

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notice
dialogues.text: Although the "Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon" requires kuuvahki to operate, it has minimal effect on humans, unlike the energies scattered around the wilderness. Please do not panic.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Look! They admitted it HAS an effect on humans! The proof is in the pudding, everyone!"

dialogues.speaker: Graceful Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Lost a brown wallet at the docks yesterday — if any kind soul finds it, please just return the fluffy Blubberbeast keychain attached..."

dialogues.speaker: Graceful Handwriting
dialogues.text: "The keychain was made by my late mother, and it's a priceless treasure to me. I'm offering 50,000 Mora as compensation to anyone who returns it!"

dialogues.speaker: Messy Handwriting
dialogues.text: "100,000 Mora for the Blubberbeast. And we make the exchange at a time and place of my choosing."

dialogues.speaker: Neat Handwriting
dialogues.text: "100,000 Mora for a keychain? That's outrageous! This one's not just a thief, they're a full-blown bandit! Whatever you do, don't give them your money!"

dialogues.speaker: Neat Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Have a word with the folks from the Curatorium of Secrets. They can help you get back what was stolen, and if you give *them* 50,000 Mora, they'll beat the stupid out of this ruffian, too!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "My household cats keep knocking my bonsai trees down. They've broken more than a dozen pots already, but I don't want to have to choose between them or my plants. Any suggestions?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I have an idea! You can buy your plants at the 'Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse'! Theirs are made with white iron alloys. Your cats could attack them, and they wouldn't even dent!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "It's true they don't break easily. I bought a few pots for my home, but one of my cats pushed a pot down when I was sitting directly under it..."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "So yeah... I can vouch for their very, very sturdy white iron alloy composition..."

dialogues.speaker: Scribbly Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Last night, I was passing by an alley near Mead-Boy, and I swear something bumped me on the back. But when I turned around, there was nothing there... I'm scared..."

dialogues.speaker: Childish Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Oh no... I heard Libuse talking about this... She said it's actually a cursed 'mark,' and if you get marked three times, you'll be doomed to wander those alleys forever..."

dialogues.speaker: Scribbly Handwriting
dialogues.text: "What!? That's awful! How do I get rid of these marks?"

dialogues.speaker: Childish Handwriting
dialogues.text: "It's easy. But first, answer this: A three-digit number, divided by its last digit, equals 37. What's the number?"

dialogues.speaker: Scribbly Handwriting
dialogues.text: "I consulted an engineer from Fontaine, and she said the answer is 185. What does this have to do with the three marks?"

dialogues.speaker: Neat Handwriting
dialogues.text: "That would be a little brat from the Conch Gang asking you to help him with his math homework... Don't ask me how I know..."

dialogues.speaker: Angry Handwriting
dialogues.text: "The bulletin board is not a target board! You treasure hunters really are a bunch of good-for-nothings!"

dialogues.speaker: Angry Handwriting
dialogues.text: "If you want to practice your marksmanship, go find a range! Don't show off your accuracy here, you're bringing shame to all of Nasha Town!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Whoa... I don't know about y'all, but this is some seriously impressive marksmanship. The word 'not' and the 'no' in 'nothings' have been shot so full of holes they're hard to even read..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Any more of that, and the message is going to turn into 'The bulletin board is a target board! You treasure hunters really are a bunch of good-for... things' or something..."
